verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an error-tracking platform could plausibly offer user-defined background automations or workflows. The evidence shows only adjacent built-in behavior: frequency-based alert rules that send email or webhooks, scheduled uptime pings, and an MCP server that external AI tools query on demand. None of these is a documented capability for users to set up autonomous automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
